Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! It is India who have managed to take a 1-0 lead and now they will have a chance to seal the series in the final T20I game. For New Zealand, it is a must-win game if they are to avoid a series loss. The third T20I will take place on the 22nd of this month and it will begin at 1200 IST (0630 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Hardik Pandya says it was a complete performance, Yadav's innings was special and the bowlers did a great job too. Adds they want to be aggressive and that is how they want to play their cricket. Adds if he can get a few more batters to bowl it will be great, it could go wrong but it went their way in this game. Ends by saying he does not expect a lot and he just wants the players to enjoy the sport.

Kane Williamson starts by crediting Yadav and says it is one of the best knocks he has seen. Adds they just could not get things going first with the ball and then with the bat. Admits it was start to bat at the start but after that, they kept losing wickets and it did not help. Ends by saying they need to think about the next game now and move ahead.

Suryakumar Yadav, man of the match, says he wanted to bat till the end and take the score to around 170. States he just looks to enjoy himself out there. Adds the win feels great and he is pretty pleased. Ends by saying he did not think a lot and just enjoyed himself out there.
...Time for the presentation...

For the Kiwis the start wasn't ideal and then they were playing catch-up and in that process they kept losing wickets. A couple of battles got off to starts but barring Williamson, none went on to make it into a significant score. However, Williamson too was a little too slow keeping the target in mind. To round it off, the Kiwis just did not turn up for this game.

The new ball bowlers hardly gave anything away in the first 6 and that built a lot of pressure on the Kiwi batters. The spinners then came on and continued the good work. Chahal was brilliant throughout his 4 overs. Sundar and Hooda were also decent, especially the latter. However, the base was set by the pacers who utilized the conditions brilliantly.
OUT! TAKEN! Hooda has three in the over. Outside off, Milne looks to go over long off but holes out to the fielder there. Singh makes no mistake. INDIA WIN BY 65 RUNS!
Commentary.Howout: c Arshdeep Singh b Deepak Hooda

Commentary.Commentary: No hat-trick. On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Southee falls now! Two in two for Hooda and he has a chance to take a hat-trick! Southee goes after it straight away. He steps out and looks to heave it on the leg side. It goes off the top edge on the off side. Pant takes it nicely.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Deepak Hooda

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! STUMPED! Hooda has his second! This is fired outside off, Sodhi steps out and swings but swings down the wrong line, probably for the turn which was not there. He misses and Pant does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: st Rishabh Pant b Deepak Hooda

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and outside off, Sodhi looks to cut but misses.
On off, this is lofted over cover for one.

OUT! TIMBER! Williamson falls of a full toss! Siraj sees the funny side of it, not the best of his deliveries but he will take it. A slower one, it is a high full toss outside off, dips a little towards the end. Williamson throws his bat at it, it goes off the inside edge and hits the stumps.
WIDE! A slower one but it is well outside off, left alone. Wided.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for two.
A bumper now on the body, Williamson shuffles in and looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Two sixes and now a boundary! This is a full toss, Williamson creams it through covers and this one races away to the fence.
SIX! Over the fence again! Angled into the pads, Kane Williamson shuffles in and whips this over the square leg fence for a biggie. Two in a row for the Kiwis.
SIX! BANG! He hit that well enough! Fuller and on off, this is lofted over long off for a biggie.
WIDE! Way too short and on middle, MIlne looks to upper cut it but misses.
Fuller and on off, this is hit to cover.
Shorter and outside off, Milne slashes but misses.
On off, this is hit through covers for one.

That is brilliant! Fuller and on middle, Williamson lofts it towards long on. For a second it seems like it is going all the way. Pandya though takes it but realises he is going over the ropes. Throws it back in. Saves four for his side.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for one.
Terrific from Siraj! The last ball is on a length and outside off, Milne looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
OUT! TAKEN! That is a well-deserved wicket for Siraj! On the pads, Santner looks to flick, he closes the face of the bat early, it goes off the leading edge back to the bowler where Siraj takes it.
Siwng and a miss! This is on the shorter side. Mitchell Santner looks to cut it but misses.
Another dot! Shorter and outside off, Santner does get bat on ball but hits it to point.
Good steam! Shorter and outside off, Santner looks to cut but misses.
Angled into the pads. Williamson looks to heave it on the leg side but misses. It hits the pad and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Angled into the pads, Williamson works it through mid-wicket for one.
This is short and slower, Williamson looks to play the upper cut but misses.
FOUR! That is caressed! Wonderful stroke! This is full and outside off, Williamson leans into it and thrashes it through covers for a boundary. New Zealand need a lot more.
Outside off, slightly shorter. Williamson looks to cut but it goes off the underedge back to the bowler.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Good call in the end then by Mitchell Santner! Length and on off, Williamson hits it to the left of long off. Williamson wants two but is sent back.
Just another signle to end! On the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Santner guides it through point for one.
On the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.

OUT! TAKEN! It is all falling apart a little too quickly for the Kiwis now. Can't blame them though, they need to go for it and Neesham looked to do that. He steps out but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He still goes ahead with the shot. Does not time it that well and holes out to Kishan at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c Ishan Kishan b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: The googly, it lands on middle, defended.
Williamson steps out and hits it down to long on and takes one.
A dot to end a terrific over by Hooda! Outside off, Neesham looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and the task keeps getting tougher for the hosts! Hooda picks up his first! He bowls it very full and on middle, difficult to get under those. Daryl Mitchell looks to go over long on but it goes more off the toe-end. Iyer takes it nicely as he runs forward and slides.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Deepak Hooda

Commentary.Commentary: Clever stuff! Slows it up, bowls it well outside off. Makes Williamson reach for it. Williamson does, it goes off the underedge towards square leg for one.
Dots will only build pressure! Fuller and on middle, this is hit hard back straight at the bowler.
Another one on the shorter side, Daryl Mitchell slaps it down to long off and it is just another single.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped down to long off for one.
Two to end! Decent over keeping the context of the game in mind! Fuller and on middle, this is lofted to the left of long on for two.
Really well bowled again! Slows it up, Williamson brings the sweep but it goes more off the toe-end through square leg for one.
Tossed up on middle, this is worked down to long on for one more.
Flighted ball on off, Williamson sweeps it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Williamson steps out Chahal slows it up and bowls it on middle, he looks to go over mid off but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for two.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A single to end then! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, Williamson works it through square leg and takes one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, Daryl Mitchell cuts it through point and takes one.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Slows it up again and lands it on middle, Daryl Mitchell works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Flatter and outside off, left alone.

OUT! TIMBER! Chahal gets his revenge! Rishabh Pant, you genuis! Chahal had bowled the last two balls a little quicker and Pant wanted him to slow it up. That is exactly what Chahal does here and gives it a little air and bowls it on the stumps. Glenn Phillips goes for another slog sweep but is through his shot before the ball arrives and it hits the stumps. New Zealand in trouble now. This is a top wicket. Glenn Phillips is the man in form for the hosts and is very dangerous.
Good comeback! Pushes it through and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
SIX! Into the stands! Glenn Phillips is on the charge here! On the pads, he gets the slog sweep out and nails it. It sails over the square leg fence for a biggie. Chahal under pressure.
That holds in the surface a touch! Shorter and outside off, Kane Williamson looks to cut but gets an underedge which goes on the bounce to the keeper. A better over from Sundar.
Lands safe! On middle, Glenn Phillips looks to pull, it goes off the top edge towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Williamson looks to cut, this goes off the top edge towards deep point for one.
Don't think that was needed! Shorter and outside off, Glenn Phillips guides it to point. It was a dot but a wayward throw from Hooda meant Pant did not collect it and a run is taken.
FOUR! That has beeen hammered! Nice way to get off the mark but that is a gift! A half volley outside off, it is slammed through covers for a boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! The stand which started to look threatening has been broken. Excellent from Pandya, despite Sundar going for 17 in his first, he kept his faith in him, gave him another over and he strikes. On the pads, this is fired through. Conway looks to play the slog sweep but it goes off the toe-end towards deep square leg where Arshdeep Singh takes it nicely.
Commentary.Howout: c Arshdeep Singh b Washington Sundar

Commentary.Commentary: Tidy from Chahal! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Flatter and on middle, Williamson works it through mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Williamson steps out but the length is shortened! It is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Pushes this one through on middle, it is pushed down to long on for one.
Well fielded by Kishan! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs to his right, dives but does not stop it cleanly. Recovers well to keep it down to two.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! Fired outside off, Williamson looks to sweep but misses.

SIX! BANG! Two boundaries and now a biggie in the over. A massive one, just the kind New Zealand needed and this could well be a momentum shifting over. This is tossed up outside off, Williamson hits it well over the long off fence for a biggie.
FOUR! This has been crunched! Second boundary in the over! Tossed up on off, Williamson hits it hard to the left of long off. Yadav gives up early. Another boundary.
Nicely played! Outside off, Williamson hits it over cover and takes two more.
Flatter and on the pads, Conway works it through mid-wicket and takes one.

FOUR! That is a top shot! Conway brings out the reverse sweep, this is on middle, he hits it well and through point for a boundary. Good way to start after the Powerplay and he straightaway puts Sundar under pressure.
On the fuller side, this is pushed towards mid on for one.
Williamson makes room! Siraj sticks it bowling it on a length and outside off. Williamson slashes, it goes off the underedge down to fine leg for one.
Fuller and on off, Williamson pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length and on the pads, Conway nudges it towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Good comeback from Siraj! Bent his back on this one, it was quicker and on the pads. Conway looks to flick but misses as he is beaten for pace.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Length and on middle, Conway hits it down the ground and into the long on fence. He hit that on the up.
Finds the fielder! Length and on off, Williamson strokes it but straight to cover.
Corrects his line and bowls it on middle, this is pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! Whipped away nicely! Fuller and on middle, Conway flicks it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary. Lovely stroke. Sheer timing.
Shorter and on middle, Kane looks to pull, it goes off the underedge through mid-wicket for one.
Good shot! Good fielding too! Shorter and outside off, Williamson pushes it through covers. Yadav in the deep, runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to two.
Misfield and a run! On middle, this moves away with the angle. Conway looks to flick but misses. It goes off a soft leading edge towards cover. Kishan does not stop it cleanly and a run is taken.
That has hit the helmet! That was really quick! Shorter and on the body, Conway looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and it hits the helmet. A single taken as it rolls on the leg side.
Just another one! Shorter and outside off, Williamson slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for another single.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On the fuller side yet again, this one swings away too. Conway looks to drive again but makes no contact.
Swing again! Fuller and around off, this one shapes away late. Conway looks to drive but is beaten.
Around off, Conway guides it down to third man for one. Brilliant from Kumar again.
Good length and on off, defended.
Outside off, Williamson slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one more.
Another beauty! Late swing. Good length again, this lands and shapes away. Williamson looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
BEATEN! Lovely nut! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Williamson pokes at it but is beaten.
Good length and on off, defended.
A single to end as this is pushed through covers.
Outside off, Williamson slashes but misses.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs! Shorter and on middle, this one lands and takes off. Williamson evades it. The keeper leaps but it goes well over the hands and into the fence.
FOUR! Clipped away wonderfully. On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket and it races away. Will that break the shackles?
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Nicely bowled! Fuller and outside pff, swings away even more. Williamson looks to drive but is beaten.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Length and on off, this moves away. Conway is beaten as he tries to block.
On off, defended.
A single as this is guided down to third man for one.
Outside off, left alone.

OUT! TAKEN! Kumar struck early and Finn Allen goes without troubling anyone. A length ball, outside off, this one swings away. Allen looks to cut but gets an outside edge to third man. Arshdeep Singh runs in, judges the dip well and takes a really good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Arshdeep Singh b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off, Allen looks to push but misses.
